parameters.name: DataQualityEvaluationTaskId
parameters.description: The ID of the associated quality check task.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The rule name for fuzzy matching.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number for paging. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 200.

parameters.name: TableGuid
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the table that the rule applies to in DataWorks Data Map.
